item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ananya wants to measure the length of her pencil using a scale.
Which method will give her the most accurate measurement?

options.A: Hold the scale above the pencil without touching it, and read the scale from an angle.
options.B: Place the scale along the pencil, read the scale with the eye directly above the end point, and write the number with its unit.
options.C: Place the scale along the pencil and write down only the number, as the unit does not matter.
options.D: Place the pencil beside the scale and guess the length by looking from the side.
